_comment: Default agent registry — the two agents the engine ships with. install.sh copies this to the runtime location (default ~/.tpmem/agent-os/registry.json), substituting __ENGINE_DIR__ with your install path. spawn-agent updates each entry's session_id when it launches the agent, and appends new entries when you spin up more agents (see docs/SELF_EXPANSION.md). Only agents with dispatcher_managed=true are driven by the dispatcher.
